label: The value of a node
subgoals: Count the factored-form literals l of the node and its n uses
Compute the change n times l minus n minus l
Read a negative value as a saving

label: Threshold elimination
subgoals: Compute the value of each candidate node
Collapse every node whose value is at most the threshold
Recompute the values of neighbors after each collapse

label: Exact change in SOP literals
subgoals: Multiply the node's SOP into each fanout cube that uses it
Count l_q times c plus L literals for each expanded use
Subtract the literals before elimination to get the change
